title: Reflexive Control in the Israeli Digital Diplomacy of Normalization; Edy Cohen's Twitter Page, a case study
screen_reason: No quantitative share of ITEMS (or people) classified false with an item denominator. Every percentage in the paper is a share of researcher-assigned 'Reflexive Control technique' codes: 883 tweets/retweets yielded 2598 technique codes ('an average of two RC techniques per tweet'), and the four process totals (Affecting the Adversary's Decision-Making 70.2%, Affecting Perception by Providing False Information 14.5%, Affecting the Timing of Decision-Making 10.4%, Power Pressure 5.0%) are shares of those 2598 codes, not of tweets. The paper never reports what share of tweets was false. Second, the numerator is a propaganda-technique taxonomy, not a veracity judgement: the largest component of the 'Providing False Information' bucket is 'Camouflage' (115/377), defined as 'showing in-depth knowledge of the enemy's culture and life with an analytical capability', which a wholly TRUE tweet can receive — the §3 test that sends such coding to QUALITY rather than CONTENT. As the only quantified veracity-adjacent measure is of that kind, this is a QUALITY-ONLY study under §3 and is excluded from prevalence. Third, the corpus is one purposively chosen account, selected precisely because its message management 'relies on conflicting and incorrect information ... rumors, and offensive content', i.e. an all-propaganda single-source set, coded by the sole author with no external ground truth and no reliability statistic. All values are recorded verbatim in missed_or_uncertain so an adjudicator can override.
missed_or_uncertain: Values seen and deliberately NOT extracted, with verbatim wording, in case an adjudicator disagrees with the screen. (a) 'The analysis show that @EdyCohen uses a number of "Affecting Perception" processes which amount to (14.5%) of the total number of RC techniques by number of tweets. This includes any tweets that contain fake news, unsourced or fabricated claims, non-credible claims with sources, claims based on previous unsourced information, etc.' Table 4 gives 'Total: Affecting Perception by Providing False Information/Total No. Of Techniques By No Of Tweets — 377 — 14.5%', i.e. 377/2598 technique codes, made up of Camouflage 115 (30.5%), Disinformation 84 (22.3%), Deliberately distorted doctrines 63 (16.7%), Deception 36 (9.5%), Enticement 34 (9.0%), Denial 27 (7.2%), Intimidation 15 (4.0%), Conceal 3 (0.8%) — several of which are not falsity codes. (b) Table 2 lists a narrower code 'False information 42 4.0%' inside the 1044 'Overload or transfer of image' codes, alongside 'Incomplete image 44 (4.2%)', 'large amount of conflicting information 39 (3.7%)' and 'Portions of the truth based on one's own perception 29 (2.8%)'; the denominator is again technique codes within one process, not items. (c) If someone insisted on an item denominator, 377/883 tweets = 42.7% — but the paper never states that, the codes are non-exclusive across tweets, and computing it would breach R8. (d) 'Sparktoro, a tool for detecting fake followers, found that 31.6% of Cohen's page followers (or 122,141 out of 386,522 followers) are fake' (the Discussion elsewhere says 31.9%). This is a share of an account's FOLLOWERS that are spam/bot accounts, audited on 2000 randomly selected accounts from the most recent 100,000 followers — not a share of content that is false, not exposure, and not a top-group concentration share, so no row. (e) 'bogus accounts are responsible for 30% of likes and 40% of retweets' — these are engagement-score components from the Sparktoro comparison tool (30% likes / 40% retweets / 20% weekly tweets / 10% following-to-follower ratio are the WEIGHTS of the engagement score, per the Dissemination section), not a measured share of engagement produced by fake accounts; the text is internally contradictory here and I would not extract it. (f) 'Retweets from these accounts contribute for 5% of the entire daily information flow' — no denominator given, no veracity judgement. NOTE ON TEXT: this is the raw (un-normalised) text file; inter-word spaces are stripped throughout ('Toalterreality...') and Arabic abstract text is interleaved, but the English is fully recoverable and the tables are intact, so text_status is ok rather than garbled.

rob.design: Single-case quantitative content analysis of one Twitter account, @EdyCohen, purposively selected as a non-official Israeli state actor; 898 tweets and retweets scraped with Vicinitas for 15 Aug - 15 Sep 2020 (the month before the Abraham Accords), 16 uncommented image/caricature posts excluded, leaving 883 analysed, coded in MAXQDA into 2598 Reflexive Control technique instances. Coding done by the sole author against a theory-derived taxonomy (Thomas 2004; Bjola 2019); no second coder, no intercoder reliability, no external fact-check or ground truth for the 'false information' codes. Follower quality assessed by a third-party tool (Sparktoro) auditing 2000 randomly selected accounts out of the most recent 100,000 followers. No population sampling, no response rate; findings are explicitly about one account and not generalisable.
